Ed25519 signatures apply to cycles after 2026-07-31, when the signing key was provisioned; we discovered and disclosed that earlier production receipts were unsigned.

evidence.note: Scoring pipeline, gate engine, and the committed forecast data under dist/.
Prediction ledger, gate decisions, provenance envelopes, and replay artifacts, committed on schedule with git timestamps.

limitations: Integrity verification requires no key; authenticity verification requires the published signing public key.
